The '''Alliance High Command''', also known as '''Alliance Command''', '''Rebellion Command''' or '''Alliance HQ''', was the leadership council of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], consisting of [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Alliance Minister of War]], the [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]] (CoS) and her closest military advisors, including [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]. Beneath Mothma, the Minister of War, and the CoS were the Alliance [[Supreme Allied Commanders]], such as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] (in charge of the Alliance Fleet) and [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] (in charge of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]).

The High Command was responsible for setting overall strategy for the Alliance, directing operations of the Alliance Fleet and [[Alliance Forces]], commanding all Alliance ground forces, and coordinating the [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Alliance Sector Commands]].

==Structure==
[[File:Alliance_High_Command.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alliance Military High Command Structure]]
In large part the brainchild of Bail Organa and his considerable knowledge of military matters from serving on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]], the Alliance High Command was flexible enough to wage coordinated insurgent warfare on a galactic scale, while still remaining under civilian control.

At the top of the High Command was the Commander-in-Chief Mon Mothma. Directly below her in the chain of command was the '''Alliance Minister of War''', the duties of whom were to keep the Commander-in-Chief (CinC) informed of military matters on a day-to-day basis. In the event the CinC became incapable of fulfilling her duties, the Minister of War would assume command of the war effort, until the CinC could return to her duties or the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]] could name a successor.

Below the Alliance Minister of War in the chain of command was the '''Alliance Chief of Staff''' (CoS), whose main duty was to act as a buffer between the CinC and lower echelons, deciding which problems required her attention, and which could be handled at lower levels. In the event either the CinC or Minister of War were indisposed, the CoS was authorized to act in their names.

Below the Chief of Staff were Supreme Allied Commanders, who were each responsible for an individual command, such as [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]], and [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForces Command]]. High Command was advised by an [[High Command Advisory Council|Advisory Council]].

==High Command headquarters==
{{Quote|Where is the Rebel base?|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
The High Command typically operated from a planetary base, from where the majority of the Alliance operations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were overseen. One of the first locations High Command used as their headquarters was a prefabricated base established in the ruins of the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. It was from the Dantooine base that the Alliance launched the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Battle of Toprawa|strike]] that saw the acquisition of the [[Death Star plans/Legends|technical data]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

From Dantooine, High Command relocated to the newly built Massassi Station inside the ruins of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Much of the Alliance's activities during this time were under the direction of [[General/Legends|General]] Jan Dodonna, operating from Yavin Base.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> After [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescuing]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the first Death Star, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] delivered her and the Death Star plans to the base. There, the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] data was analyzed, and the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|assault on the Death Star]] was launched.<ref name="ANH" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] soon responded with a blockade of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], and within six months of the Death Star's destruction, High Command was forced to evacuate the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and relocate elsewhere.

Following the evacuation from Yavin, High Command was forced to become increasingly mobile as the Empire intensified its efforts to destroy them. To greater protect them, the newly formed starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] was permanently assigned to the roving High Command group. In accordance with policy established by Mon Mothma, the bulk of the Alliance Fleet was to operate separately from High Command in order to avoid a catastrophe that would potentially destroy both. It was decided the Alliance could survive the loss of either its [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] or High Command, but not both. While reconnaissance teams were dispatched in an effort to locate a suitable site for High Command to permanently relocate to, they temporarily settled on the planet [[Thila/Legends|Thila]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Thila Command|Thila base]] was only used for a few months before it too was evacuated in the face of the threat of its location having been compromised. Rogue Group performed admirably during several skirmishes in the Thila campaign, helping High Command to evacuate. High Command had already decided on relocating more permanently to the ice planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. When construction on the new [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] was completed in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], they moved their operations there under the command of General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]. It was a mark of their desperation that they were forced to hide themselves within the ice caverns of the remote and desolate Hoth.<ref name="GG3" />

High Command operated out of Echo Base for about a year before it was discovered in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], his personal armada of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Vader launched a crushing [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|ground assault]] that severely damaged the Alliance's war efforts. Only with another heroic effort by Rogue Group did much of High Command narrowly avoid destruction at the hands of the Empire and evacuate the ice planet. The surviving members of High Command, now without a planetary base, relocated to the predetermined [[Haven (rendezvous point)|rendezvous point]] with the Alliance Fleet beyond the galactic rim.<ref name="GG3" />

With the Alliance facing a situation more desperate than ever before, High Command transferred their operations to the Alliance Fleet, using Admiral Ackbar's [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Home One/Legends|''Home One'']] as their mobile base of operations for the following year. When High Command discerned the location and details of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], still under construction above the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]], they ordered the majority of the Alliance Fleet to convene above the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], where they planned the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault on the battlestation]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
